title: Composite LCFs on neto1: does a composite's own head beat its formula on the estimates of its parts?
description: exp-neto1-heads-233 trained neto1 with 34 heads, the 12 composites of docs/lcf-concepts.md among them, and left one question open: a composite's head is redundant unless it beats the formula applied to its parts' heads. This reports, with no training, each of that run's three seeds on the same rows (experiments/net1_train.py --eval): per view and composite, the R^2 of the head and the R^2 of the formula on net1's estimates of the parts (fit.report_net1's derived). summary.md holds both for every view; composites.json the validation means, the only rows a choice of heads may use.
run: R="$IN/h/net1-point-all34-s$SEED"; uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/composites-s$SEED" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set 'output={"kind":"point"}' --set dropout=0.05 --set "lcfs=$(jq -c .spec.lcfs "$R/report.json")" --seed $SEED --stride 24 --eval "$R/net1.pt" --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" "$IN/w/campaign-wide30" "$IN/w/campaign-wide120" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --ood rtt-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-rtt-wide" --ood buffer-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-buffer-wide"
